name: Fiscal Deficit (share of FY27 target)
description: The centre's fiscal deficit so far this financial year as a share of the full-year Budget Estimate. By the end of August 2026 the deficit stood at about ₹7.1 lakh crore.
releaseSchedule: Released monthly, at the end of the following month.

chart.title: Two-fifths of the full-year target used by August

chart.source: CGA data via Daily Excelsior (July) and Deccan Chronicle (August)
